launches.body:
# **Hi!**

We’re **Moncef DJAFRI** and **Mariem Ould Ismail** from 🇫🇷 Paris, and we’re building **Stockline**.

---

# **TL;DR**

**Stockline** is an **AI-native ERP** for food wholesalers — automating manual order entry and replacing their clunky software from the 90s.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92425&key=user_uploads/2131140/29e05c95-954b-4073-9a4c-32fa93e0e7a2)

---

# **WHY WE CARE**

Mariem’s father is a fish wholesaler. 🐟 Back in high school, she spent her summers helping him — and watched him waste hours every day retyping orders, chasing invoices, and drowning in paperwork. ✏️

That’s where the idea was born.

Mariem and Moncef met at **École Polytechnique** in France, where we went through years of military training, rigorous math, and team projects.

We were both admitted to **MIT** and **Stanford**, but chose to focus on **Stockline’s mission**: bringing tech to an industry long overlooked by digital transformation.

---

# **THE PROBLEM**

Most food wholesalers still rely on software from the 90s.

One symptom among many: **Orders come in through WhatsApp, SMS, email, or phone calls — and get retyped manually into their ERP.**

Admin work takes over.\
Headcount grows just to keep up with repetitive tasks.\
From quoting to delivery, everything is **manual, error-prone, and slow**.

They barely use data. **Prices are set by instinct**, with no visibility into stock or margins. And most tools out there just don’t match how they actually work.

This leads to:\
→ Mistakes\
→ Tight margins\
→ Food waste

---

# **THE SOLUTION**

**Stockline replaces outdated ERPs with AI at the core.** The game-changer? **No more manual data entry**.

Our AI captures orders from every channel — **WhatsApp, SMS, email, even phone calls** — and feeds them straight into one unified system.

We centralize:\
• Communication (WhatsApp, emails, SMS…)\
• Operations (billing, inventory, CRM…)

**All in one platform. Admin disappears.**

Once you have all the data in one interface, the sky’s the limit! And the broader vision is to rethink ERPs entirely so that wholesalers finally get to focus on what really matters:\
→ Their products\
→ Their customers\
→ Their margins

https://youtu.be/TsbPuwGhZhs?si=u5U0orZ_aIgIVbJE
